title: The Symmetry Budget: How Much Group Structure Should a Network Architecture Assume?
abstract: arXiv:2611.33169v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A network architecture is, in large part, a symmetry assumption: convolution ties weights across translations, attention ties them across permutations, and a fully connected layer ties nothing. When the data are only approximately symmetric, tying trades approximation error against estimation error, and the right amount of tying is a property of the dataset, not of the architecture alone. We study this trade-off in an exactly solvable model: linear maps on signals over the cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_d$, with architectures indexed by the subgroup lattice of $\mathbb{Z}_d$, so that a single integer $k \mid d$ interpolates between an unconstrained layer ($k=1$, $d^2$ parameters) and a fully equivariant one ($k=d$, $d$ parameters). We derive the finite-sample excess risk in closed form, show that for a generic symmetry defect the leading-order risk is affine in $1/k$, and prove that intermediate architectures are then never strictly optimal:

translated_title: 对称性预算：网络架构应该假设多少群结构？
translated_abstract: 网络架构在很大程度上是一种对称性假设：卷积将权重在平移之间进行绑定，注意力机制将权重在置换之间进行绑定，而全连接层则不做任何绑定。当数据仅具有近似对称性时，这种绑定会在近似误差与估计误差之间进行权衡，而适当的绑定程度是数据集的属性，而非仅由架构本身决定。我们在一个精确可解的模型中研究这种权衡：循环群 $\mathbb{Z}_d$ 上信号的线性映射，其架构由 $\mathbb{Z}_d$ 的子群格索引，使得单个整数 $k \mid d$ 可以在无约束层（$k=1$，$d^2$ 个参数）和完全等变层（$k=d$，$d$ 个参数）之间进行插值。我们以闭式形式推导了有限样本超额风险，证明对于一般的对称性缺陷，主导阶风险与 $1/k$ 呈仿射关系，并证明此时中间架构永远不会严格最优：
tldr: 该论文提出“对称性预算”概念，在一个精确可解模型中以闭式形式推导出有限样本超额风险，证明当数据仅具有近似对称性时，网络架构中的中间对称性绑定程度永远不会严格最优。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "symmetry budget" concept and, using an exactly solvable model with closed-form finite-sample excess risk, proves that intermediate architectures are never strictly optimal when the data possess only approximate symmetry.
